transcript.text: I have an exception to the draft plan. The production's city green-film incentive requires at least 85 percent of dismantled set material by weight to be diverted from landfill, and the approved vendor's audited plan reaches that threshold only through separate wood and metal recycling bins plus a certified transfer record. I confirmed the correct plan with the vendor this morning, but the compliance packet still contains the general-salvage draft. My corrective requirement is: replace the general-salvage vendor disposition for scenic pieces with the audited wood and metal recycling bin plan plus certified transfer record, so the compliance packet matches the approved diversion plan before dismantling on Friday. I'm requesting this be entered into the meeting record as a Sustainability Department exception assigned to Lina.
